title: Check Zombie Processes
description: Count zombie processes and report them for investigation.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

COUNT=$(ps -eo stat= | awk '$1 ~ /^Z/ {count++} END {print count+0}')

echo "Zombie processes: $COUNT"

if (( COUNT > 0 )); then
    echo "WARNING: Zombie processes detected."
    ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,comm | awk '$3 ~ /^Z/'
else
    echo "OK: No zombie processes detected."
fi
